expected_return_files.baseline_fit_summary.json: baseline parameter vector, timing span, residual RMS or chi2 summary, and code/data release identifiers
expected_return_files.carrier_projection_rank.json: six-real-coordinate three-carrier projection rank, singular values, and rank threshold
expected_return_files.configuration_manifest.json: active Nutimo configuration, specialcase flag, delay flags, fitted parameter names, and target carrier extraction settings
expected_return_files.decision_summary.md: one-page verdict using the Request 10.7 pass/fail language
expected_return_files.dynamic_chi_test_column.tsv: synthetic dynamic-chi residual column and carrier-level complex amplitudes for the shared-tau transfer
expected_return_files.finite_jacobian.npy_or_tsv: ntoa by nfit residual derivative matrix for the standard fitted parameter set
expected_return_files.synthetic_injection_recovery.json: refit result for the minimal shared-tau injection, including pre/post carrier amplitudes and residual projection onto the finite nuisance span

hard_stop_rules: dependency repair replaces the science gate
RN_PL-like harmonic soak-up is enabled on target carriers
target carrier inventory collapses below the required sample count
dynamic-chi test column lies in the finite nuisance span
promotion_rule: promote only if configuration closure passes, projection rank is <=5, dynamic-chi column survives the finite nuisance span, and minimal synthetic shared-tau injection is recovered after refit

rows.external_owner_action: Declare the pre-provisioned Nutimo/Tempo2/Boost/Minuit environment; do not report dependency repair as science.
rows.notes: This keeps the pilot from becoming an infrastructure project.
rows.required_input: public Nutimo source/data release and runnable environment
rows.validation_rule: must identify code release, data release, executable path, and whether residuals plus finite gradients can be computed

rows.external_owner_action: Export active fit parameters, delay flags, specialcase flag, target carrier list, and any harmonic nuisance blocks.
rows.fail_interpretation: collapse if target-carrier harmonic soak-up is enabled
rows.notes: This is the first stop rule from Request 10.7.
rows.pass_interpretation: standard finite state/geometry core is testable
rows.required_input: baseline par/tim and active Nutimo run configuration
rows.validation_rule: RN_PL-like or equivalent harmonic soak-up must be explicitly listed as enabled or disabled for the target carriers

rows.external_owner_action: Extract the three target carrier frequencies: Omega_in, Omega_out, abs(Omega_in-Omega_out).
rows.fail_interpretation: falls back to weaker two-carrier or one-carrier gate
rows.notes: This is not a new harmonic search; it uses existing GR carriers.
rows.required_input: inner/outer periods and outer-dipole combination component
rows.validation_rule: frequencies must be positive, distinct, nonresonant at the 2:1 collapse cases, and nonzero in projection

rows.external_owner_action: Compute residual derivatives with respect to the standard finite fitted parameter set near the baseline solution.
rows.notes: This is the minimal useful runtime calculation before posterior work.
rows.pass_interpretation: finite nuisance span is available for rank test
rows.required_input: runnable residual function and fitted parameter scales
rows.validation_rule: columns must correspond to named fitted parameters, not carrier-local Fourier amplitudes

rows.external_owner_action: Project the finite nuisance Jacobian onto the six real coordinates of the three carrier complex amplitudes.
rows.fail_interpretation: named implementation behaves like carrier-local soak-up
rows.notes: Report singular values and rank threshold, not just an integer.
rows.pass_interpretation: dynamic-chi remains runtime-motivated if test column also survives
rows.validation_rule: rank <= 5 supports finite shared phase/geometric manifold; rank 6/6 is the per-carrier complex collapse class

rows.external_owner_action: Construct the synthetic shared-tau residual column using G(z)=c_Y+beta/(1+tau_chi z) on the target carriers.
rows.fail_interpretation: dynamic-chi collapses into named finite nuisance span
rows.notes: Use several finite tau_chi values away from zero-frequency collapse.
rows.required_input: chosen tau_chi, beta, c_Y, carrier amplitudes, and projection convention
rows.validation_rule: column must be tested for membership in the finite nuisance Jacobian span

rows.external_owner_action: Inject the shared-tau carrier perturbation and refit only the standard finite nuisance parameters.
rows.notes: This is a sanity pilot, not a detection or final posterior.
rows.required_input: baseline residuals, finite Jacobian or fit routine, dynamic_chi_test_column
rows.validation_rule: post-refit carrier relation must be tested against one shared tau_chi and against the admitted finite derivative comparator

rows.external_owner_action: Return a one-page verdict using the exact labels: runtime-motivated, conditional, collapse.
rows.fail_interpretation: dynamic-chi closes for this named implementation class
rows.notes: Do not convert a failed pilot into an open-ended source chase.
rows.pass_interpretation: dynamic-chi is a named runtime-worthy positive branch
rows.validation_rule: must state which stop rule triggered, or why external runtime work is promoted

scope: external handoff packet for Request 10.7; this repo does not perform the Nutimo runtime run
